title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta14

Stabilization beta for notifications, state semantics and private-cloud log noise.

### Changed
- Stop creating the duplicate local `Mowing task completed` notification when the vendor already reports task completion.
- Treat a mowing transition observed inside an active native schedule period as native schedule context instead of incorrectly calling it an external mowing task.
- Map observed private-cloud state `0212` as `Manual mowing` and keep it in the active polling profile.
- Keep one-off private-cloud transport failures at debug level; warn only after 3 consecutive failures (then again at 10/25) while continuing to retain last-good data.

### Unchanged
- Navimower Schedule orchestration from beta13 is unchanged.
- Maintenance and Mowing Reports discovery remains paused.
- Clear and resume / Reboot Mower discovery remains unchanged and read-only while waiting for a useful live error diagnostic.
